name: AWS VPC IPv4 standard subnet
scope: Standard IPv4 VPC subnet, excluding BYOIP
exceptions: AWS documents a BYOIP exception allowing all IPv4 addresses. Select the explicit byoip variant to model that capacity.

name: Azure VNet IPv4 subnet
scope: General IPv4 subnet; individual Azure services can require a larger minimum
exceptions: Service-specific subnet size requirements and forbidden address ranges require separate validation. IPv6 subnets are /64.

name: Google Cloud primary IPv4 subnet range
exceptions: Secondary IPv4 ranges do not reserve these four addresses; select the secondary variant. Validity also depends on restricted ranges, route conflicts, and service constraints.
